'''The Sign''' is a [[Effects|Potion Effect]] added in v1.10.0. This effect can be applied to players and animals alike and makes them undetectable to parasites. It is a Creative-Only effect, only applied through commands or while holding [[Debug_Items#The_Sign|The Sign Item.]]

The Sign cannot be removed by drinking Milk.

The Sign does not stack.
